steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Hair ties, a water cup, and a throw pillow...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Gotta bring all of these with me!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: And this book too. Anna's gonna be so happy! And this music player... Sonya can listen to her songs!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Hm? What's this photo...?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: It's... from the day I graduated elementary school. Mama and Papa came home early so the three of us could have this picture taken.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Papa, Mama...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Lada, are you ready yet?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Sorry, I'd like to let you stay a little longer, but we can't be in Ursus too long. Things will get pretty ugly if we're found out.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The transport team didn't give us much time, so we've got to hurry.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Oh, sorry, I'll be out in a sec!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Packing up took a little longer than expected. This place has gotten a little messy, and there's a lot of stuff I can't find.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Damn them, those Reunion bastards... Look what they did when the city fell into chaos.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: So, Lada, what are you planning to do next? Is there some other place you'd like to go?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Um... I think I'm pretty much good!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: After Granny passed away, I was living alone anyway, so it's fine. Just gotta pack up my stuff and go!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I see... It must've been hard living by yourself at your age.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Ehehe, it's not that bad. I've already gotten used to it.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Granny taught me how to cook, and I cooked for her for years!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: That's impressive. Compass's bunch once mentioned that a little girl who knew how to cook local specialties from our hometown had shown up, but didn't have a chance to try her cooking...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: But, be honest with me, Lada. Are you sure you want to come with us?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: What's the matter? Why are you asking me such a serious question all of a sudden...?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Well, I've already made up my mind! I want to be with Sonya and the others!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Haha, I'm glad all of you still get along so well.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Though... that's not what I was trying to ask.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Look, even though the outside plates are being accommodated by other cities and the people can only stay in the asylum shelters for the time being, things are gradually returning to normal.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Sooner or later, Chernobog's going to get rebuilt too. In a little while, returning to live here might be a viable option.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Hrmm....

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: To be honest... I'm not totally sure. Right now, I want to be with my friends, but as for what comes after that...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Mister Pointedneedle, if my friends decided to leave, I'm sure they already decided what they want to do. Both Anna and Sonya...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: But me...? Where can I go next?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Sorry, I can't answer that for you. That's something for you to think about.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Lada, your situation isn't like that of Anna and the other girls. Even though you said you don't know exactly where your parents work, and there's no information about them in the registry...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'm sure Rhodes Island would be able to help you if you put in a request...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: In any case, I don't think you need to rush yourself to a decision.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: ...I didn't rush this decision at all!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: I know you're just trying to look out for me, but...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Right now, I want to be together with my girls. As long as we're together, there's no place we can't go!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: As for what comes after that... I'm not too sure. I haven't really thought about it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Lada...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: But, your parents...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Papa and Mama... They're always working somewhere else. They rarely came home anyway, and they never told me where they work. They rarely even wrote to me.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Even if those bad people didn't attack the city, I already hadn't seen Papa and Mama for a long time before that.

steps.name: Warm Woman
steps.text: Lada, Papa and Mama are heading out for work.

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: Lada, you listen to Granny now. Be a good girl and wait for us to come home, okay?

steps.name: Tender Girl
steps.text: Papa, Mama, are you abandoning me again?

steps.name: Tender Girl
steps.text: *Sniffles*...

steps.name: Tender Girl
steps.text: Papa, Mama, don't go... I don't want to be an orphan... Waah...

steps.name: Warm Woman
steps.text: Lada...

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: It's almost time.

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: Lada, Papa and Mama have to go now.

steps.name: Tender Girl
steps.text: No... Waaaaaaaaaahhhh!!

steps.name: Tender Girl
steps.text: Don't go! Papa, Mama, don't leave me!

steps.name: Tender Girl
steps.text: Don't abandon me...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: So, I'm gonna go wherever I want to go! Nobody's gonna care anyway!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: That's the way things are!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I, I see.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: (Is this girl... deliberately uncooperative? She's pretty worked up.)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Well, I guess you can come with us for the time being. Given the current situation though, I'm not sure we can let a kid your age live alone.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: If there's no other place you want to go, then you can stay at Rhodes Island for now, just like that Sonya girl.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: You mean, become an operator like Sonya? I've never thought about that before.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It's not easy to become an operator.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: So once you're done packing, let's get going?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Mmkay!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Just gimme a little more time! I wanna bring that pan with me too!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: More stuff? Are you sure you can carry it all?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I guess that's goodbye to Chernobog.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The rendezvous point is just up ahead. Looks like we made it with some time to spare.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Thank you, Mister Pointedneedle! I couldn't fit all the kitchenware in my bag. Thank you so much for helping me out!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Don't worry, it's not a big deal. Besides, this wouldn't be the first time I carry water, or rather, a pan, for someone.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Err, don't worry about it, it's nothing... Hey, watch out!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Woah!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: I'm fine, I'm fine...

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: ...Lada?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Emperor above, it's really you!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: It's... Auntie Polina!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Someone you know?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Mhm! She's the nice auntie from next door who always looked after me!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Auntie Polina, I'm so glad you're safe!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: I was about to say the same, young lady!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Lada, you have no idea how much this means to me. We heard that the students were trapped inside the school, and after that, we searched everywhere for you. We were worried sick!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Where've you been all this time?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: I was with my friends from the school. Rho-... Err, I mean, some nice people rescued us.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Nice people...? Do you mean that gentleman next to you?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hello, Madam Polina.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: ...Hello.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: (I've never seen this man before. What a strange look to him...)

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: (I say, Lada, are you sure the people who 'saved' you are trustworthy? You're not being tricked, are you?!)

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: (I'm not! Mister Pointedneedle is a great person!)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...Ahem.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: R-Right! More importantly, how've you been, Auntie?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Those bad guys didn't hurt your family, right? Are Uncle Zegna and Sister Clara fine?

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Yes, they're fine. Everyone's safe and sound.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: The police in our area responded quickly, and led us out to the wastes to hide until things settled down.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Zegna led a search party to look for you at the school, but when we didn't find anyone there, we had to leave.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: I'm just so glad that you're alive and well, Lada! His Majesty the Emperor truly smiles upon us!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: It's not like the Emperor did anything for us though. We only made it out because my friends and I looked out for each other.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Huh? Lada, what did you say just now?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: ...Uhh, nothing!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Don't worry, Auntie Polina! I'm totally fine, because I'm super strong now!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: If bad guys ever try to bully us again, just tell me, and I'll help everyone drive the bad guys away!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Haha, our little Lada has already grown into such a reliable young woman!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Heh heh! I'll grow up to be even stronger and more reliable!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: When that time comes, I'll make sure none of those bad guys who wrecked the city get away! I'll smack 'em silly with my frying pan!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Are you talking about the frying pan I'm carrying on my back?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: That's the one!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: That's a pretty nice goal to have. Keep at it, kiddo.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Lada, there's not much time. We should go.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Ah, okay!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Okay, Auntie Polina, I have to go now...

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Go? Wait, Lada, you didn't come to visit us? Wh-What do you mean you have to go?

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: I know we're only allowed to live in the asylum areas right now, but the conditions there aren't that bad. Soon enough, all these houses are going to get rebuilt.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Lada, isn't your home right here? Where are you going?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: My home...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Auntie Polina... I'm really glad I could see you again. But, but!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: But, I want to be with my friends more than ever now... Anna, Sonya, and Natalya and Rosalind too. I don't want us to be separated.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: If I can't be with them... I don't know what I'll do. The thought is too scary...

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Lada...

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: If you have nowhere to go, just go home. Let's go home, okay?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: My house is ruined. Papa and Mama won't come back. I don't have a home anymore.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: But you don't have to worry about me. I'm going somewhere that's super safe!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: There are lots of people there, and they'll be real nice to me!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Isn't that right, Mister Pointedneedle?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Yes. We will be able to guarantee her safety, at the very least.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We would never expose a student of Lada's age to situations that are too dangerous.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Ooh... Sonya would be super mad if she heard you say that.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: She's already decided on becoming a full-fledged operator. I think she's even picked out her codename!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Forgive me then. I'd never dare say that to her face.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: I suppose you've already made up your mind then. In that case, I won't ask too many questions. Just remember to write back often!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: As long as you're safe, then Uncle Zegna and I will feel at ease. Go out and see the world, but stay safe... And when our city is rebuilt, it's never too late to come back...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Wait, Lada!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: I have something to give you! I've kept it with me, hoping I'd be able to give it to you one day.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: This is for you. Your parents gave it to our family for safekeeping a few years before they set off.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Huh? It belonged to Papa and Mama?

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: They said that if they couldn't make it back for your middle school graduation, to give it to you then.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: But you're leaving now, and I don't know when I'll be able to see you again. So, this is probably the best time to give it to you. You must cherish it.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: What's inside this box? Is this... a videotape?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: And a photo... of the time I graduated from elementary school. With all our names written on it.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: This was supposed to be a gift to you, right?

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: I can't believe I still haven't heard a word from your parents even after such a major incident! Unbelievable, they still haven't written home in all these years!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: ––No, that's not it!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Papa and Mama... They're just, too busy with work...

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Oh... If you can still believe that, then it's for the best.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Your parents... and their job. I heard it's not easy. It might even be harder than ours.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: When your grandmother was still with us, was always worried sick. She'd come around and chat with me, and well... 'Even if they were busy investigating something, how could they not spare the time to see family?'

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: In any case, promise me you'll take care of yourself, Lada. No matter where you go, remember to let me know how you're doing.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: I won't waste any more of your time then. Hurry along now.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Papa, Mama...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Are you alright, Lada?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Yes, I'm fine.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Mister Pointedneedle, I... I think I might know what I want to do next!

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: Good girl, Lada. Don't cry.

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: Papa and Mama are doing work that is very important to Ursus, so we won't be able to stay with you often. We also won't be able to write back much...

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: But, we would never abandon you, Lada. You're Papa and Mama's precious baby.

steps.name: Tender Girl
steps.text: But, but... the other kids said...

steps.name: Tender Girl
steps.text: They said nobody wants me...

steps.name: Warm Woman
steps.text: How could that be? Papa and Mama love you very much. Those kids just don't know better.

steps.name: Warm Woman
steps.text: We might be apart for a while. We might not be able to see each other, or even talk to each other. When we miss each other, maybe the only thing that will keep us going is a little memory.

steps.name: Warm Woman
steps.text: It's our fault that we won't be able to watch you grow up, but always remember... Lada, Papa and Mama will always love you.

steps.name: Warm Woman
steps.text: No matter where we are, no matter what path you choose in the future...

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: We will always support you.

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: And whenever we get the chance, we'll definitely come back to be with you.
When I was little, the other kids would always make fun of me for being an orphan. A parentless street kid.
I felt terrible. I'd cry and tell my parents on the rare occasions they came home.
Not long after that, for some unknown reason, the kids stopped making fun of me. And they never did again. The big girl next door would gently pat my head, and say to me:
'I'm so sorry about before. Your parents are amazing researchers.'
My Papa and Mama are amazing.
But I rarely get to see them.
On the day I graduated from elementary school, Papa and Mama came back.
We went to the graduation ceremony together. We took pictures together, and went out to all kinds of fun places.
Papa and Mama said they didn't want to miss me growing up. So no matter how tough things were, they'd try to be with me on my most important days.
Papa and Mama said they wanted me to know more about their lives, so they recorded them and passed them down to me so that I'd have more company whenever I missed them.
Does that mean as long as I keep growing up, I'll be able to see Papa and Mama again?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Hum hum~ Hum dee dum~

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Istina, did you take the picture? You did, right? I finally passed the test!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hold on, Lada, slow down a little...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Phew... Alright, there you go. By the way, why'd you suddenly decide to start chronicling your life?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Hmm... I guess, to record a bit more of my growth. It's a secret surprise!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Oh right, Istina! Since I passed my test, I'm now an official operator, just like you and the others! Remember to call me by my codename now!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Gummy! My codename is Gummy!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Okay, Gummy.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: That's going to take some time to get used to. You could always refer to yourself in the third person, in the meantime.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, right! Good idea!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Gummy's gonna work super hard to protect my friends, and everyone else at Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Good morning, Lada, Anna.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Morning.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Mister Pointedneedle! Good morning!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You can't call me Lada anymore! I'm a full-fledged operator now, so call me Gummy!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Haha, well done. Congratulations.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, Mister Pointedneedle, Gummy had a question for you!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hm? If you need help with something, feel free to ask away.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Does Rhodes Island... have a school? Can Gummy keep studying?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Where is this coming from?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'm afraid we don't have anything like a formal school, but we do have training courses and general education courses.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Really? Does that mean I can continue studying then?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Of course. With that proactive attitude, any teacher would be delighted to have you in class.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Actually, even if you didn't bring it up, I assume there would be a dedicated operator who'd let you know.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The Doctor specifically checked in on you girls to make sure you could continue your education. You might not even be able to get away if you wanted to!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: ...Zima's head is going to pop right off.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Haha, she's not gonna make it easy for the teacher though.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Papa, Mama... I live in a place called Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Even though... Even though there are a lot of things I don't understand here, and some things that are scary to think about...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: As long as I'm with my friends, I know I'm going to be alright!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Papa, Mama, make sure you work hard too. I'm going to write to Auntie Polina and tell them how to reach Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If you want to write back, or come to visit, Auntie Polina will tell you where I am, and then we can meet up at Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Besides, I'm really mad that you left me alone for so long, and weren't there for me during the scariest part of my life!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Because I'm really, really mad, I might not be able to forgive the two of you. So when we meet, we might fight a lot!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But... Well, no matter how much we fight, we'll still be family, right?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If Papa and Mama are too busy and can't find the time... Then I'll find you myself!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But, I can't do that yet. I've already changed a whole lot, and that might be scary to you...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'll get over those... Those not-so-good habits of mine!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: There are lots of people here who will help me get over them. Anna and the other girls... We'll put those nasty things behind us, and we'll all be happy!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: So wait for me...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm going to grow up to be the best that I can be!
